model: The home popup banner track slid for 500ms, then waited for transition end before jumping the loop clone back. The slide is gone. A clone index still resets on the next commit, and the clone shows the same poster as the real slide.

noise.rule: 30 is round(500ms * 60 / 1000). The reset still commits once after the clone index, but that commit shows the same poster. Not a sampled compositor trace.
